mindlin_traction — DRIVE tacslip op

• Data kinds: matrix × table → matrix

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.mindlin_traction(r, mp: 'dict') -> 'np.ndarray' (to call the implementation directly, import tacslip; tacslip.mindlin_traction(r, mp: 'dict') -> 'np.ndarray'; from the registry, opsdrive.get("mindlin_traction"))

Usage

> This operator's description has not been translated yet. The original text follows as it is.

接線トラクション q(r) = q′ − q″ [Pa]: q′ = μp0√(1−r²/a²)(r < a)、q″ = μp0(c/a)√(1−r²/c²)(r < c)。滑り環 c ≤ r < a では q = μp(r)

(Coulomb の限界に張り付く)、固着円では q < μp。`mp は :func:mindlin_partial_slip` の表。r と同じ形。Raises ValueError: mp に a/c/mu/p0 が無い。
